answered.sql: SELECT pw.workshop_id, pw.workshop_title, GROUP_CONCAT(t.technique_name) AS techniques FROM Photography_Workshops pw JOIN Photography_Workshops_Techniques pwt ON pw.workshop_id = pwt.photography_workshop_id JOIN Techniques t ON pwt.technique_id = t.technique_id GROUP BY pw.workshop_id, pw.workshop_title

candidates.meaning: Find the techniques for every photography workshop.
candidates.sql: SELECT pw.technique_id, t.technique_name FROM Photography_Workshops pw JOIN Photography_Workshops_Techniques pwt ON pw.workshop_id = pwt.photography_workshop_id JOIN Techniques t ON pwt.technique_id = t.technique_id

candidates.meaning: List all techniques used in every photography workshop.
candidates.sql: SELECT technique_name FROM Techniques WHERE technique_id IN (SELECT technique_id FROM Photography_Workshops_Techniques WHERE photography_workshop_id IN (SELECT workshop_id FROM Photography_Workshops))

candidates.meaning: List the unique techniques used in every photography workshop session.
candidates.sql: SELECT DISTINCT t.technique_name FROM Techniques t JOIN Photography_Workshops_Techniques pwt ON t.technique_id = pwt.technique_id JOIN Photography_Workshops pw ON pwt.photography_workshop_id = pw.workshop_id

candidates.meaning: List the techniques associated with each workshop leader for every photography workshop.
candidates.sql: SELECT p.name, pw.workshop_id, t.technique_name FROM Photographers p JOIN Photography_Workshops pw ON p.photographer_id = pw.workshop_leader_id JOIN Photography_Workshops_Techniques pwt ON pw.workshop_id = pwt.photography_workshop_id JOIN Techniques t ON pwt.technique_id = t.technique_id
